title: God's Got Beef: The Priests Are Lowkey Scammers
paragraphs: § No More of This So-Called Worship!
Alright, so here's the 411. God has a message for the people of Israel, and he's delivering it through his prophet, Malachi.
God straight up says, "I love you guys."
But the people are skeptical, like, "For real? How have you even shown us love?"

God's reply is basically, "Dude, just look at history. See how differently I treated your ancestor Jacob compared to his brother Esau? I chose Jacob and rejected Esau. I totally wrecked Esau's territory and turned his whole country into a ghost town."

When the Edomites (Esau's descendants) were all like, "We got knocked down, but we'll just rebuild and be better than ever," the LORD of Heaven's Armies said, "Go ahead, try me. When I knock you down, you stay down. People will look at your land and call it 'The Evil Territory' and you'll be known as 'the people God cursed.'"
"Yeah, for real, take a good look. Then you'll see how loyal my love for you has been, and you'll want even more. You'll be saying, 'May God's greatness be known even beyond the borders of Israel!'"

"Okay, real talk. A son respects his father, and a servant respects his master, right? So if I'm your Father, where's my respect? If I'm your Master, where's the honor?" The LORD of Heaven's Armies is calling you out, you priests. "You despise my name!"
And you're like, "No way! How are we despising you?"
"By offering lame, messed-up sacrifices during worship. That's how."
Then you ask, "What do you mean, 'messed-up'? What's so bad about it?"

"It's when you say, 'The Lord's altar isn't a big deal anymore; worship isn't a priority.' That's how it's messed up. And when you bring worthless animals for sacrifices—the blind, sick, and injured ones you're just trying to get rid of—isn't that messed up? Try pulling a stunt like that with your governor. You think he'd be impressed?" asks the LORD of Heaven's Armies.
"So now, go ahead and beg God to be nice to you. But since you priests caused all this trouble, do you really think he's going to listen to you?" asks the LORD of Heaven's Armies.

"Honestly, I wish one of you would just lock the Temple doors so you can't come in and play these fake religious games with your empty worship. I'm not happy," says the LORD of Heaven's Armies. "And I don't want any more of your so-called worship!"
§ Offering God Something Hand-Me-Down, Broken, or Useless

"My name is honored by people all over the world. From east to west, they know how to worship me right, honoring me by bringing their absolute best. They're all saying it: 'God is great, this LORD of Heaven's Armies.'"

"But not you guys. Instead of honoring me, you're disrespecting me. You do it when you say, 'Worship is whatever, and what we bring doesn't matter,' and when you complain, 'Ugh, this is so boring, I get nothing out of it.' You act all high and mighty, looking down your noses—at me, the LORD of Heaven's Armies! And the sacrifices you do bring are just leftovers, broken or useless. You really think I'm going to accept that? This is God telling you straight up!"

"So a curse on the person who pretends they're doing something big for me—like promising an expensive sacrifice—but then swaps it out for something cheap and worthless at the last second. I'm a great King," says the LORD of Heaven's Armies, "and my name is respected everywhere. I'm not going to tolerate this disrespect!"

title: God's Calling You Out, Priests!
paragraphs: § Desecrating the Holiness of God

Alright, priests, listen up. This one's for you. If you don't start listening to me and giving me the respect I deserve—I'm the God of Angel Armies, btw—then I'm gonna curse you. All those blessings you have? Yeah, they're turning into curses. Actually, it's already happening because you're not taking me seriously. And this curse is gonna hit your kids too. I'm gonna smear nasty, rotten trash from your own parties all over your faces. Have fun with that.

Maybe that'll finally get your attention. Maybe then you'll get that I'm calling you out to bring back the deal I made with your ancestor Levi. That was a promise from the God of Angel Armies, you know? My deal with Levi was all about life and peace. I kept my end of the bargain, and he respected me for it. He was genuinely in awe of me. He taught the truth, no cap. He was my boy, always doing the right thing. He saved a ton of people from messing up their lives.

It's a priest's job to teach the truth. People are supposed to go to them for real guidance. The priest is a messenger from the God of Angel Armies. But you guys have totally bailed on that. Your teachings have messed up so many people. You've wrecked the deal I had with Levi. The God of Angel Armies is saying it, so you know it's real. And that's why I'm exposing you for what you are. Everyone's gonna be grossed out by you and stay away because you don't live like I told you to, and you twist my words instead of teaching them straight up.
Don't we all have the same Dad? Didn't the same God make all of us? So why are we always fighting? Why are we disrespecting the promise our ancestors made that's supposed to hold us together?

Judah totally cheated on God—it's a disgusting betrayal in Israel and Jerusalem. Judah has dishonored God's holy standards by falling for and marrying foreign women who worship other gods. God's curse on anyone who does this! Kick them out of their homes! They're not fit to be part of the community anymore, no matter how many gifts they try to bring to the God of Angel Armies.

And here's another thing you're doing wrong: You flood the temple with your crying and complaining because you're not getting what you want from God. You wanna know why? It's simple. God was there when you made your wedding vows to the bride you married when you were young. And now you've broken those vows. You broke the sacred bond with your partner, your wife by covenant. God made marriage, not you. His Spirit is in every part of it. And what does he want from marriage? Godly kids, that's what. So protect the spirit of your marriage. Don't cheat on your spouse.
"I hate divorce," says the God of Israel. The God of Angel Armies says, "I hate the violent tearing apart of the 'one flesh' of marriage." So watch yourselves. Don't let your guard down. Don't cheat.
You're making God tired with all your talk.
"How are we making him tired?" you ask.
By saying stuff like, "God is cool with sinners and sin." and "Judgment? Nah, God's too nice to judge."

title: God's Messenger is Coming & He's Got Receipts
paragraphs: § The Master You’ve Been Looking For

“Yo, check it! I’m sending my messenger ahead to clear the path for me. Then, bam, out of nowhere, the Leader you’ve been looking for will just show up in his Temple—yep, the Messenger of the Covenant you’ve all been waiting for. Look! He’s on his way!” This is a direct message from the God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
But for real, who’s gonna be able to handle that? Who can even survive when he shows up?

He’ll be like a blazing hot fire in a furnace. He’ll be like the strongest soap you can get. He’s gonna sit down like a silversmith, purifying and cleaning everything up. He’ll scrub the Levite priests clean, refining them like gold and silver, until they’re good enough for God, ready to make offerings that are actually righteous. Then, and only then, will Judah and Jerusalem be right with God and pleasing to him, like they were way back in the day.

“Yeah, I’m coming to you with judgment. I’ll be a witness against sorcerers, cheaters, liars, people who rip off their workers, those who take advantage of widows and orphans, and those who are rude to immigrants—basically anyone and everyone who doesn’t respect me.” A message from the God-of-the-Angel-Armies.

“I am God—yeah, I Am. I haven’t changed. And because I haven’t changed, you, the descendants of Jacob, haven’t been totally wiped out. You guys have a long history of straight-up ignoring my rules. You haven’t done a single thing I’ve told you. Come back to me so I can come back to you,” says the God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
“You ask, ‘But how do we come back?’
“Start by being honest. Do honest people rob God? But you guys rob me every single day.
“You ask, ‘How have we robbed you?’

“The tithe and the offering—that’s how! And now you’re all under a curse—the whole nation—because you’re robbing me. Bring your full tithe to the Temple treasury so there’s plenty of food in my Temple. Test me in this and see if I don’t throw open the windows of heaven for you and pour out a blessing so huge you won’t know what to do with it. I’ll protect your crops from pests, and your fields and gardens won’t be raided.” The Message of the God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
“You’ll be called the ‘Happiest Nation.’ You’ll see what it’s like to be a country full of grace.” The God-of-the-Angel-Armies says so.
§ The Difference Between Serving God and Not Serving Him
God says, “You’ve said some really harsh, rude things to me.
“And you ask, ‘When did we ever say that?’

“It was when you said, ‘It’s pointless to serve God. What do we get out of it? We did what he said, walked around looking all serious for the God-of-the-Angel-Armies, and what difference did it make? The people who do whatever they want are the lucky ones. They break all the rules and still get ahead. They push God to the limit and get away with it.’”

Then the people who truly honored God got together and talked about it. God saw what they were doing and listened in. A book was opened in God’s presence, and minutes were taken of the meeting, with the names of everyone who feared and honored God’s name written down.

The God-of-the-Angel-Armies said, “They’re mine, all mine. They’ll get special treatment when I make my move. I’ll treat them with the same care and kindness that parents give a child who respects them. And you’ll once again see the huge difference between someone who does the right thing and someone who doesn’t, between serving God and not serving him.”

title: The Final Showdown: Good vs. Evil
paragraphs: § The Sun of Righteousness Will Dawn

Yo, for real, a day is coming that's gonna be like a massive wildfire. All the proud, evil people? They're gonna get torched like kindling, totally burnt up. Nothing left but scorched earth and ash. It's gonna be a dark day for them. But for you guys who respect my name? It's gonna be like a sunrise. The sun of justice will show up, bringing healing vibes. You'll be super energetic, like a young horse just let out to play. And you'll totally crush the wicked—they'll be like dust under your feet on that day. That's a promise from the God of Angel Armies.
Don't forget the instructions I gave through my boy Moses, the stuff I commanded at Horeb for all of Israel—all the rules for how to live right.

But also, get ready for what's next. I'm sending the prophet Elijah to prep everyone for the huge Day of God—the ultimate Judgment Day! He's gonna get parents to actually care about their kids, and kids to respect their parents. If they don't, I'll have to come and basically curse the whole land.
